skill.name: okx-growth-competition
skill.description: Manage OKX Agentic Wallet trading competitions from discovery and registration through rankings, reward claims, and optional winner contact submission.
skill.summary: Discover competitions, register wallets, track rankings, and claim eligible OKX rewards.
skill.author: okx

security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives caused by Markdown paths, inline code, schema field names, and documented CLI syntax. One instruction reads outside the audited skill directory, while semantic review found an unconfirmed swap path and unescaped leaderboard content.

remediation.issue: The preflight dependency is read from outside the audited skill directory.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle the preflight file inside this skill, or declare and audit a fixed dependency before reading it.

remediation.issue: The direct contract-address trading path executes a swap without a final transaction preview.
remediation.suggestion: Show chain, input amount, input token, output token, contract address, minimum received, fees, and slippage before requiring explicit confirmation.

remediation.issue: Backend-provided leaderboard nicknames are rendered verbatim.
remediation.suggestion: Escape Markdown and HTML, remove control characters, enforce a display length, and treat nickname text only as data.

content.value_statement: Tracking competition rules, registration, rankings, and rewards across wallet accounts is complex. This skill guides the complete OKX Agentic Wallet competition workflow.
actual_capabilities: Lists active and ended OKX Agentic Wallet competitions.
Shows supported chains, schedules, rules, and prize pools.
Registers an authenticated wallet account for an eligible competition.
Displays leaderboards, personal rankings, and estimated rewards.
Checks reward eligibility and claims eligible on-chain rewards after confirmation.
Submits one optional contact method for qualifying top-tier winners.
limitations: Requires the OnchainOS CLI or matching MCP tools for live actions.
Registration, personal status, claims, and contact submission require wallet login.
Competition availability, rankings, eligibility, and rewards depend on OKX backend data.
Trading and reward claims can create irreversible blockchain transactions and network fees.

use_cases.title: Compare Available Competitions
use_cases.description: Review active competitions, supported chains, schedules, rules, and prize pools before choosing one.

use_cases.title: Track Competition Standing
use_cases.description: Check every leaderboard, current rank, qualifying threshold, and estimated reward for a selected competition.

use_cases.title: Process Winner Rewards
use_cases.description: Verify reward status, confirm an eligible claim, and optionally submit contact details for merchandise delivery.

prompt_templates.title: List Competitions
prompt_templates.prompt: Show all available OKX Agentic Wallet trading competitions. Separate active and ended competitions.

prompt_templates.title: Review Competition Details
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the rules, supported chains, schedule, and prize pools for [competition name].

prompt_templates.title: Check My Ranking
prompt_templates.prompt: Check my rank across every leaderboard for [competition name]. Include current values, thresholds, and estimated rewards.

prompt_templates.title: Claim an Eligible Reward
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether I won a reward in [competition name]. If eligible, show the complete claim preview and wait for my confirmation.

output_examples.output: A table of active competitions with names, supported chains, dates, prize pools, and official detail links.

output_examples.input: What is my rank in Agentic Trading Contest?
output_examples.output: Separate ranking sections for each leaderboard, including current position, score, qualifying threshold, and estimated reward.
An eligibility result followed by a claim preview showing the reward amount, token, and chain before confirmation.

best_practices: Confirm the competition name and wallet account before registration or reward actions.
Review supported trading chains from current competition details before placing trades.
Verify every claim preview and keep optional contact sharing limited to one preferred method.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the reward chain as a supported trading chain without checking competition details.
Do not execute swaps or claims without an explicit transaction preview and confirmation.
Do not expose internal activity, chain, or account identifiers in user-facing responses.

faq.question: Can this skill list active and ended competitions?
faq.answer: Yes. It can request all competitions or filter results by active or ended status.

faq.question: Does registration require wallet login?
faq.answer: Yes. Registration uses the authenticated Agentic Wallet account and its resolved wallet addresses.

faq.question: Can it check every leaderboard?
faq.answer: Yes. It can retrieve all leaderboards for one competition and show personal standing on each.

faq.question: Will it claim rewards automatically?
faq.answer: No. The documented claim flow requires an eligibility check, a reward preview, and explicit user confirmation.

faq.question: Why might a reward be unavailable?
faq.answer: The user may not have won, may have claimed already, may have an expired reward, or may await final results.

faq.question: When are contact details requested?
faq.answer: Only qualifying top-tier winners are invited to share one optional contact method after a successful claim.
